name: hermes-session-panel
description: Hermes Desktop plugin: side panel with the focused chat's agents, environment, context, connectors, outputs and changes.

scripts.build: esbuild src/plugin.jsx --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=react --loader:.py=text --external:@hermes/plugin-sdk --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --minify --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* Session panel for Hermes Desktop. Source: src/ in this repo. */" --outfile=session-panel/plugin.js
